value.rationale: The first possible 3-party house expansion is a canonical natural boundary, not an arbitrary small parameter slice. The complete open polygon and normalized area 1/72 quantify a finite-size house-monotonicity failure not answered by existing asymptotic probabilities. The exact volume is a reusable baseline for apportionment risk, tie-free census verification and comparison with other methods.
